tickets.title: Complete beneficiary update workflow
tickets.text:
Use this workflow when a client needs to add, remove, or revise beneficiary designations. Confirm the requested change, gather the required custodian forms or online instructions, submit the update, and verify the custodian's final confirmation before closing the loop with the client.
Confirm the IRA beneficiary designations for Paige Lanternmoss and Darin Lanternmoss as requested, determine the correct Velvet Acorn Custody process, and flag any trust language that may require estate attorney review, completing this by 2025-11-14.

subTasks.title: Confirm beneficiary instructions
subTasks.text: Review the client's requested beneficiary changes, including primary and contingent beneficiaries, percentages, relationship details, and any per stirpes or trust-related language. Flag anything that requires attorney or estate planning review.

subTasks.title: Prepare custodian documentation
subTasks.text: Identify the correct beneficiary update method for each affected account, prepare forms or portal steps, and confirm whether spousal consent, medallion signature guarantee, or trust documentation is required.

subTasks.title: Submit and track update
subTasks.text: Submit the completed documentation through the approved custodian channel and track the request until the custodian confirms the beneficiary record has been updated.

subTasks.title: Confirm completion with client
subTasks.text: Send the client a concise confirmation that the beneficiary update has been completed, noting any accounts still pending or any items the client should retain with estate documents.

tickets.evidence: They agreed on follow-up by 2025-11-14 to confirm the requested designations, identify the correct custodian process, and flag any trust wording that may require estate attorney review.

tickets.title: Review charitable transfer readiness
tickets.text:
Review the proposed charitable transfer using these criteria and collect supporting evidence:
- Confirm intended recipient is a qualified charity or eligible donor-advised fund sponsor.
- Confirm asset type, estimated value, cost basis if available, holding period, and whether appreciated securities are involved.
- Confirm source account registration and authority to give transfer instructions.
- Verify delivery instructions, including recipient name, tax identification details if provided securely, custodian delivery method, and any special purpose or designation language.
- Check whether the gift should be coordinated with the client's tax advisor for deductibility, AGI limits, bunching strategy, or required minimum distribution treatment.
- Confirm whether the client needs an acknowledgment letter, gift receipt, or confirmation for tax records.
- Evidence to collect: client authorization, current position or cash balance, charity delivery instructions, custodian form or portal confirmation, and final transfer confirmation.
Prepare the charitable gift of appreciated Copper Firefly Systems shares to Marzipan Meadow Arts Fund, gather the charity delivery instructions, address tax coordination questions, and obtain confirmation evidence for Paige Lanternmoss's records by 2025-11-21.
tickets.evidence: They agreed on follow-up by 2025-11-21 covering the proposed asset, charity delivery instructions, tax coordination questions, and confirmation evidence needed for Paige’s records.
